Category: Object.
Subject: piano accordion.
Style: Italian mother-of-pearl.

critiqueTurns.text:
REVISE

Good
- Stradella bass button board on the left casing features a clear staggered multi-row button layout.
- Rubber feet are present on the base.
- Mother-of-pearl celluloid material color matches the intended Italian styling palette.

Issues
- keyboard_deck -> The piano keyboard is currently mounted horizontally, floating detached from the casing, and bisected by an erroneous vertical slab; reposition it vertically along the front-right bevel of treble_casing tilted outward 25 degrees, remove the vertical cutting slab, and mount white and black keys along the height of the keybed.
- bellows_core -> The central bellows is completely collapsed/invisible and its geometry has inverted winding; rebuild the flexible air chamber as 16 prominent pleated folds bridging between the bass and treble casings (from x = -0.08m to +0.08m, y = 0.03m to 0.41m, z = 0.22m), colored cardinal red (#8A1C24) with outward face winding.
- bellows_frames_corners -> Add the rigid chrome-edged end-frames and triangular metallic bellows corner brackets (#E0E4E8) along the pleat corners to separate the bellows cleanly from the two pearlescent body casings.
- treble_grille -> The front sound grille is completely missing; model a gold/brass (#D4AF37) pierced filigree decorative panel seated flush into the front inset recess of treble_casing.
- treble_registers -> Tone-selector switches are currently reduced to tiny stray specks; build a distinct satin black mounting strip with angled rocker switches and chrome accents positioned along the inner edge of the keyboard deck.
- shoulder_straps -> Twin dark leather suspension straps are distorted, floating, and clipping awkwardly into the body; anchor them securely from rear upper brackets, curving cleanly over the top edges down to lower attachment lugs.
- bass_wrist_strap -> The wrist strap on the outer bass panel lacks proper depth and the knurled tensioner wheel; arch it with a realistic hand clearance gap (0.04m) across the bass plate.

Style: Oaxacan alebrije painted wood.

critiqueTurns.text:
REVISE

Good
- Rich Oaxacan folk-art color scheme with vibrant turquoise, scarlet, cobalt, marigold, and pumpkin orange.
- Rosette relief dots and decorative rings add authentic alebrije carved ornamentation.
- Triangle count (10,760) makes good use of the prop budget.

Issues
- wings_left & wings_right -> Wings are mounted vertically along the spine like a mohawk fin instead of fanning outward from the shoulders to an 1.8m span; rotate and spread them laterally to x = -0.25m and +0.25m angled 40 degrees upward.
- wings_left & wings_right -> Feather blades are zero-thickness single-sided planes that vanish completely in the Low back view due to backface culling; extrude them into solid beveled plates with outward-facing normals and real thickness.
- forelegs_talons -> Forelimbs are severed and floating in mid-air with open flat cylinder ends; join the teal upper legs to the orange avian shanks with seamless angled geometry instead of disconnected primitives.
- head_hybrid -> Muzzle is a plain rectangular red box and lacks the hooked raptor beak; replace the box with a merged feline jaw and a curved, downward-hooking golden eagle beak (#FFB703).
- hindlegs_paws -> Thighs terminate in flat downward-facing cutoffs with separate cylinders dropped below them; model continuous muscular feline hindquarters tapering through the hock into padded paws.
- serpent_plume_tail -> Tail terminal feather blades disappear from behind, leaving an open hollow tube cut; cap the swept tube and model solid double-sided extruded fins for the ornamental three-feather fan.
- torso_core -> Shoulder joints and limbs read as raw stacked cylinders and unblended spheres; merge and taper the leg roots into the torso to read as a single sculpted wood carving.

critiqueTurns.text:
REVISE

Good
- The five-headed hydra silhouette, heavy forelimbs with talons, and coiled tail establish the intended monster silhouette from the front-right view.
- Pale horn tone on the dorsal spikes provides clear, readable contrast against the dark leathery hide.

Issues
- hydra_necks_inner_pair, hydra_necks_outer_pair, hydra_heads_inner_pair, hydra_heads_outer_pair -> reverse face winding to counter-clockwise outward order so all four flanking necks and heads render from every camera angle instead of vanishing completely in Front left, Top, and Low back views.
- hydra_head_center, hydra_heads_inner_pair, hydra_heads_outer_pair -> replace vertical faceted cylinder cans and flat red cuboids with forward-facing horizontal wedge skulls, open gaping lower jaws, crimson mouth cavities, and sharp needle fangs.
- hydra_dorsal_spikes -> attach all floating bone cones firmly to the dorsal ridges of the neck and spine geometry instead of leaving them hovering in empty space.
- hydra_torso -> raise the lower chest and belly curve so the underside rests at y = 0 rather than dipping underneath the ground plane.
- hydra_neck_center, hydra_necks_inner_pair, hydra_necks_outer_pair -> loft the neck tubes along dynamic organic S-curves with flared throats, reducing redundant tube segments to bring the 18,904 triangle count closer to the 10,000 budget while gaining genuine anatomical form.

Subject: spaceship galley kitchen.
Style: Alien (1979) Nostromo.

critiqueTurns.text:
REVISE

Good
- Captures the grimy, utilitarian 1979 Nostromo industrial sci-fi aesthetic in its individual consoles, CRT screen, and diamond quilt motif.
- Triangle count matches the prop guidance closely while providing detailed console greebles and curved piping.

Issues
- galleyKitchen -> Fix the X-axis coordinate alignment across all sub-assemblies; components are scattered across a 3.5m span (from x = -1.2m to x = 2.3m) instead of aligning into a cohesive 2.4m wide station centered at x = 0.
- counterBase -> Center the carcass at x = 0 so it supports the prepCountertop; currently the solid cabinet base is shifted over a meter to the right while leaving the left cabinet doors floating under empty air.
- overheadStorageHood -> Center the upper locker/extraction hood at x = 0 directly above the counter and bulkhead; currently it floats far out to the right cantilevered over empty space.
- paddedBulkhead -> Populate the diamond-quilted padding across the full 2.3m width of the back panel; currently only 6–8 diamond pads exist clustered on the left edge, leaving the center and right as a flat bare slab.
- prepCountertop -> Align the countertop with the base carcass and bulkhead at x = 0, y = 0.85m, so it sits flush on top of the counterBase.
- conduitHarness -> Route conduits to terminate cleanly into the top of the counter and base rather than clipping straight through the open prep surface into void space.
